findings.message: Test placement violates .claude/rules/bdd-unit.md, whose table marks 'Keyboard accessibility | no (unit) | yes (E2E)' and 'aria-labels, focus management | no | yes'; the acceptance criteria repeat it: 'keyboard, layout, real-browser behaviour in E2E, not in jsdom'. Tasks 5.1/5.2 (and design D5) still add locations_search_shortcut_unit.feature, a vitest-cucumber feature that tests the '/' keyboard shortcut in jsdom: synthetic keydowns, focus() on an input/textarea/contenteditable it appends itself, and 'focus on its close action' for FR3. The task only requires plain unit tests for the ignore cases (already in tasks 2.1/3.1/4.2). Remove the unit BDD feature or limit it to non-keyboard rules, and cover FR6 (unreadable list) another way, e.g. a component test.

proposal.md Impact claims `constants/` gets 'the `/` key and DOM constants', but design.md D2/D3 make CONTENT_EDITABLE_SELECTOR, NON_TEXT_INPUT_TYPES and KEYDOWN_EVENT module-local ('Both constants are module-local'), and tasks.md only adds KeyboardKey.SLASH to constants/keyboard.ts. The proposal and design disagree; make them consistent.

NFR-R1 says 'the 8 approved screenshots of the list and empty states at 375 px and 1024 px in both themes', but the repository has 16 such baselines: 8 under src/test/features/__screenshots__/chromium/ and 8 under __screenshots__/mobile-chrome/. M5 counts them differently ('8 list and empty screenshot examples (run in both the chromium and mobile-chrome projects)'). Fix the count in NFR-R1 so it agrees with M5 and the files.

Task 5.2 says to append the text-entry elements to document.body and 'remove it in BeforeEachScenario/AfterEachScenario with closeApp', but closeApp in steps/locationsUiWorld.tsx is only `cleanup(); localStorage.clear();`. RTL cleanup() unmounts only containers it rendered, so the manually appended input/textarea/contenteditable elements are never removed. The task relies on helper behaviour that does not exist and should remove the elements explicitly.

findings.message: Test placement violates the acceptance criterion "Tasks put each test where .claude/rules/bdd-unit.md and bdd-e2e.md say it belongs (keyboard, layout, real-browser behaviour in E2E, not in jsdom)". bdd-unit.md marks "Keyboard accessibility | no | yes" and "aria-labels, focus management | no | yes" (unit BDD | E2E BDD), and ADR-0001 says "vitest-cucumber runs in jsdom — no real focus, aria, layout". Yet proposal.md Behavior says "The ignore cases (FR2–FR4, FR6) and lazy data (NFR-P1) are covered by Vitest unit and component tests, not by a Gherkin feature", and the single E2E scenario (task 5.1) covers only the happy path. The spec scenarios "Typing in a text field", "Search already open", "Modifier keys held", "Shift on layouts that need it" and "Stored list unreadable" are keyboard behaviours verified only in jsdom (tasks 2.1, 3.1, 4.2, 4.3). Add playwright-bdd scenarios for them (FR2–FR4, FR6), and keep the pure-predicate Vitest test only as a mutation target.

FR2's spec clause "the `/` is entered into that element" cannot be verified by tasks 2.1/3.1: in jsdom a dispatched synthetic KeyboardEvent never inserts text, so the tests only check that dispatchEvent returned true (not prevented). The observable behaviour the spec promises has no real-browser test.

FR3 (task 4.2 and design D5: "presses `/` while focus is on the dialog's close action") depends on real focus placement inside the Radix dialog, but it runs in jsdom ("no real focus", ADR-0001). It needs an E2E scenario in a real browser.

UX1 ("the browser's own action for `/` (for example Firefox quick find) does not start") is verified only as dispatchEvent returning false in the jsdom hook test (task 3.1). That is a real-browser behaviour, and no E2E step asserts it, e.g. that the `/` reaches neither the query field nor the browser after the search opens.

findings.message: tasks.md task 5.8 says the outlines tagged in 5.7 run "in `chromium` and `mobile-chrome`". That is wrong for the accessibility outline. It is tagged `@view-contract` (locations_view_contract_e2e.feature:59: `@add-locations-via-search @view-contract @NFR-A1 @UX5 @M3`). playwright.bdd.config.ts sets `grepInvert: VIEW_CONTRACT_TAG_PATTERN` on both `chromium` and `mobile-chrome`, and only the `view-contract-<id>` projects run it (`grep: VIEW_CONTRACT_TAG_PATTERN`). The axe-core examples for NFR-A1/M5 therefore run in `view-contract-cards`; only the screenshot outline (NFR-R1) runs in `chromium`/`mobile-chrome`. Fix the project claim in 5.8, and mention it in 5.7's verification if needed.
